title: powermanagement dataengine's `Inhibitions` source is permanently empty: `ListInhibitions` is demarshalled as a type that matches neither introspection nor the wire
line: Apps that are already blocking sleep now show up in the Display Configuration applet's presentation mode hint.
explanation: PowerDevil's PolicyAgent sends ListInhibitions (and InhibitionsChanged) as aas, a list of {who, why} string lists, but the powermanagement engine asked for a(ss) (QPair<QString, QString>). QtDBus rejects the ListInhibitions reply for the signature mismatch, so the callback never runs and inhibitions that already existed when the Inhibitions source was requested never appear (e.g. no "… is enforcing presentation mode" hint in Display Configuration). Inhibitions added later still arrived through the signal. The change makes InhibitionInfo a QStringList, matching what PolicyAgent sends, and reads name/reason from its first two entries.

commits.message:
dataengines/powermanagement: read inhibitions as PowerDevil sends them

PowerDevil sends ListInhibitions and InhibitionsChanged as lists of string
lists, but the engine asked for string pairs, so the reply was rejected and
inhibitions already active never showed up. Read them as string lists.

BUG: 523640

media.caption: Konsole holds an inhibition (ListInhibitions returns it), but Display Configuration shows no hint
Same steps with the fix: "Konsole is enforcing presentation mode: rig test reason"

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in plasma5support that aligns InhibitionInfo with the QStringList (aas) wire format PowerDevil's PolicyAgent.ListInhibitions actually sends, removes the redundant QStringList metatype registration, and reads name/reason safely via .value(0)/.value(1). Keeping the existing {Name, Icon, Reason} DataEngine shape avoids breaking consumers like Display Configuration in this deprecated compatibility library, and the before/after screenshots and probe logs verify both pre-existing and live inhibitions.
